name: heigan
_comment: Heigan's eruption dance as data via the generic 'timed_safe_zone' shape (parameterized HeiganDanceAction). Two instances differ only in cadence -- slow (15s/10s) and fast (7s/4s) -- sharing 4 safe-zone centers + the triangle-wave walk 3-2-1-0-1-2 (see BossNotes/Heigan.md). 'hold'=1 (fast): own the tick when parked, never cast (tight 4s cadence). 'hold'=0 (slow): yield once parked so casters DPS/heal between eruptions. 'cast_while_moving'=1: while EN ROUTE, yield the tick so each bot's OWN rotation fires INSTANTS as it relocates -- the engine refuses cast-time spells while moving (CanCastSpell), so only instants come out (zero risk of rooting into an eruption). The 'suppress' rule below is what makes cast_while_moving safe: while Heigan is engaged it zeroes the movement-hijackers (avoid aoe / reach spell / combat formation move / flee) so they can't grab the yielded tick and pull a bot off the dance route. (json-raid has InitMultipliers now -- this is the data-driven form, the analog of the C++ HeiganDanceMultiplier; also lets four_horsemen carry its dropped multiplier.) reach MELEE is deliberately NOT suppressed so slow-phase melee can still close on the platform. WHO/WHEN stays on the proven C++ triggers (Level-1). PRIORITIES 31/32 (relevance 91/92) beat avoid-aoe@90 -- json-raid priority isn't clamped, it's an offset on ACTION_RAID(60). Test 25-man; A/B with .rjson off.

rules._comment: Fast dance (everyone): teleported up, Plague Cloud channel, +7s/+4s eruptions. hold while parked (no cast), cast instants while moving.
Slow dance, ranged: +15s/+10s eruptions. Yield once parked (cast freely, incl cast-time -- 10s window) and cast instants while moving between wedges.

Slow dance, tank + melee: park on the SE platform (no eruption GOs, outside the Spell Disruption bubble). Kept as the proven C++ 'heigan platform' action -- its final-8s bleed-off onto the dance is Heigan-specific timing glue.

suppress._comment: FAST phase (all roles dancing). Zero everything that would hijack a yielded dance tick: the eruption-dodge / range-chase / formation / flee movement AND 'heigan dance' -- the C++ Naxx strategy stays in the queue (ApplyInstanceStrategies re-adds 'naxx' on zone-in even after .rjson on), and its heigan dance @ ACTION_RAID+3 would otherwise catch the tick json safezone yields and HOLD it, so the rotation never fires (= no instants). 'reach melee' IS suppressed here: Heigan is teleported up but still targetable, so a freed melee bot would chase him off the dance floor. This is the data-driven HeiganDanceMultiplier.

SLOW phase (ranged dance, tank+melee on platform). Same suppression MINUS 'reach melee' -- slow-phase melee need it to close on the tanked boss at the platform. 'heigan dance' is suppressed so the C++ slow-ranged dance @ +2 doesn't steal yielded ticks from json safezone; 'heigan platform' is NOT suppressed (the json platform rule uses it). Gated by aura-absence so it covers all roles (the C++ slow triggers are role-split).
